purpose: Which evidence-critical suites exercise the PRODUCTION invocation path, and which exercise a component directly. Required by #345: a component test is insufficient when production wraps that component with a transformation.

transform_vocabulary.identity: the orchestrator renames or remaps the identity passed to the component (build-security-summary.sh passes the channel as --tool-name and the producer as --producer-key)
transform_vocabulary.configuration: the orchestrator resolves or overrides configuration the component would otherwise read
transform_vocabulary.scope: the orchestrator changes what the component analyses
transform_vocabulary.aggregation: the orchestrator merges several producers into one channel or summary field
transform_vocabulary.none: no shipped orchestrator materially transforms this contract

rule: When orchestrator_transforms is anything other than 'none' AND production_path_mandatory is true, the SUBJECT must be exercised through that orchestrator by at least one suite, named in subject_covered_through_orchestrator_by. A suite whose own coverage_status is 'direct-only' may NOT name itself; a suite that does drive the production layer may.
